cards.text: King Solomon of Israel has built the house of the LORD and his own palace (2 Chronicles 8:1), and he is FAMOUS. Word of his fame reaches the queen who rules the land of Sheba. So she sets out for Jerusalem.

cards.question: The queen of Sheba has heard all about Solomon's fame. What is she coming to Jerusalem to do?

answers.text: Make a peace treaty with him

cards.text: She arrives in Jerusalem with a very large caravan, camels loaded with spices, gold in abundance and precious stones. Friend, that's not luggage, that's a PARADE.

cards.question: The queen of Sheba talks with Solomon about everything on her mind. True or false: one of her hard questions finally stumps him.

cards.text: Questions answered, the queen does a FULL inspection. Solomon's wisdom, his palace, the food at his table, where his servants sit, what his attendants and cupbearers are wearing, and the burnt offerings he presents at the house of the LORD.

cards.question: Seeing Solomon's wisdom, palace, table, servants and offerings takes the queen of Sheba's ___ away.

cards.text: She tells the king that the report she heard in her own country about his words and wisdom is true. Friend, she showed up to TEST the man and ended up writing him a REVIEW.

cards.question: True or false: the queen of Sheba believed the reports about Solomon before she came and saw him for herself.
Now that the queen of Sheba has seen Solomon with her own eyes, how does he compare to the reports she heard?

cards.text: Then she calls Solomon's servants blessed, the ones who stand before him all the time and hear his wisdom. Meanwhile, back in the junk drawer I spent years stuck in, I listened to dead batteries argue over who had the most charge left.

cards.question: After praising Solomon's servants, the queen of Sheba says one more name should be blessed. Whose?

cards.text: She says the LORD delighted in Solomon and set him on His throne, to be king for the LORD his God.

cards.question: The queen of Sheba says that because God loved Israel, He made Solomon king over them to carry out ___ and righteousness.

cards.text: Then the queen gives the king 120 talents of gold, a great quantity of spices and precious stones. Turns out that parade was a DELIVERY.

cards.question: True or false: there had never been spices like the ones the queen of Sheba gave King Solomon.

cards.text: The servants of Hiram, king of Tyre (2 Chronicles 2:3), and Solomon's servants, the ones who brought gold from Ophir, also brought algum wood and precious stones. Solomon makes that wood into steps for the house of the LORD and for his palace, and into lyres and harps.

cards.question: Nothing like Solomon's algum-wood work had ever been seen in Judah. Who are the lyres and harps for?
Before she leaves, King Solomon gives the queen of Sheba whatever she asks for. True or false: it adds up to less than she brought him.

cards.text: Then the queen of Sheba heads back to her own country with her servants, after getting back even more than she gave. Me? I hand somebody a cookie box and I'm thrilled if I get a thank-you.
